# Screens and implementation coverage (master list)

<!-- Generated by redesign/tools/figma/gen_screens.py. Do not edit by hand: change the generator and rerun it. -->

Single source of truth for what to build. It merges the 45-item inventory of `spec/spec-part2.md` (column **Inv#**), the screens and panels of `spec/spec-part1.md`, every Figma frame/component set (see `figma/INDEX.md`) and the SrDouglax node inventory (`../research/from-forks/srdouglax/reference/inventory.json`, same node ids). Design: VLC Redesign by Juxtopposed, Figma community file https://www.figma.com/community/file/1691465999134370980, CC BY 4.0 (attribution required).

Columns:
- **Figma**: node id and render. "in X.png" = the node is a variant inside that component-set render (find it by node id in `figma/figma_file.json`). Empty = not designed; build from the spec and the shared tokens/components.
- **Spec**: section link (`p1` = spec-part1, `p2` = spec-part2). **Video**: keyframes under `../reference/video/frames/` (local only, not in git; links are relative to this file).
- **VLC**: the core functionality each screen needs (libvlc core / vlc_player / vlc_playlist / vlc_ml / config names). "app-side" = no VLC API, store in the app.
- **Phase**: P1 player shell & controls · P2 side panels & subtitles · P3 library/music/streams/playlists · P4 settings/hotkeys · P5 customization/onboarding/profiles. Shared tokens: `tokens/`; icons: `figma/ICONS.md`.

## Implementation status

Updated 2026-10-17 for branch `claude/final` (checkout `.`).

- **Status** `implemented UI`: the native SwiftUI/AppKit state exists and its supported
  actions reach the VLC backend. At `ddd9d23a9d` every area passed independent
  verification (505 Swift tests, all native suites, install). It does not by itself mean
  visual acceptance.
- **Parity · live**: visual parity against Figma and the video, from the eight offscreen
  parity judges (`../research/final-polish/results/resume/parity.json`,
  160 checks: 101 match, 39 minor, 2 major, 1 missing, 17 not checked;
  worst verdict per S-id, owning area in brackets; `not judged` = no check named the
  screen). The judges ran on the tree committed as `ddd9d23a9d`; fixes of the final-polish
  wave after it are not yet re-judged. Live results (in square brackets: which run and
  build) come from real-window groups (`../research/final-polish/results/parity/live-run-1-window.json`;
  run 1 screenshots lost, measurements stand). Every kept difference must be covered by a
  `DECISIONS.md` entry.
- Unsupported operations are not offered (D035); an operation that exists but cannot
  run now shows why.

Capability limits: S17 reverse playback is unavailable; S18 HDR stays Auto-only (owner,
2026-10-16) and unsupported resolution overrides are not offered; S20 unsupported
subtitle styles are not offered and cached renderer fields apply to the next media; S21
cue timelines support readable local SRT, WebVTT and ASS/SSA sources; S27 online
OpenSubtitles needs an API key/proxy; S37 physical disc/camera/microphone inputs need
hardware validation; S62 installs, removes, enables and runs local Lua extensions through
the bridge's extension-dialog provider (D039, D045), and the online add-on catalog is
not offered.
